lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder, adoption and new_flow, and finish and redesign changes, as only one test has been completed for each.
No clear effect was seen for adoption and redesign changes across 2 tests.
Finish and new_flow changes hurt performance across 2 tests, resulting in negative noise-corrected effects and one test stopped early.
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests, though round 7 predicted lower than measured.

candidates.title: Story Screen Split Card Layout
candidates.change: Reframe the initial story screen layout into a clean split card structure separating pet lore from path options.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a very high mean time of 514s, indicating users pause or get lost in the unorganized layout.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Companion

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the story screen layout within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long step duration on choose_path, but lacks support mail backing and requires new card layout UI.

candidates.title: Sign In Multi Device Account Warning Hint
candidates.change: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that signing in restores existing pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing into your existing account automatically syncs and protects your adopted pets.

guard.reason: Valid account hint text added to sign-in screen without violating pricing or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment between support tickets (8 emails) and funnel sign-in drop-off; low risk hint addition.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Photo Preview Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Insert a photo confirmation step after photo upload where users inspect image framing before starting pet creation.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 issues regarding custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion is low at 60.9%.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_photo_review']

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Naming Inspiration Carousel
candidates.change: Add a carousel of popular pet names and personality ideas directly onto the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption takes a long median time (89s) and mean time (1017s), showing users stall when naming or adopting their pet.

components.text: Need name ideas? Try classic names like Barnaby, Ziggy, or Mochi!

guard.reason: Valid addition of name tips carousel to the adoption certificate screen.

candidates.score_note: High potential impact given adoption's steep 39.1% drop, but adding a carousel requires new UI components.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Launch Status Notification Toast
candidates.change: Show estimated waiting time and ready notifications on the waiting screen while pet assets initialize in the background.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted pets failing to appear or app stalling, and home waiting screen takes median 201s.

guard.reason: Valid waiting-screen timing estimate and notification settings added.

candidates.score_note: Backed by both support tickets and long home waiting time, though target step already has high conversion.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Cheat Sheet Onboarding Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Add a brief walkthrough sub-flow explaining how to drag, talk to, and minimize the pet from the system tray.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to pets, and finish conversion drops to 64.8%.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_controls_walkthrough']

candidates.title: Home Intro Card Spotlight Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight card highlighting primary pet interactions.
candidates.why: The finish step has a massive mean duration (5815s) and only 64.8% conversion, showing dropoff right at the final step.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is active on your desktop! Use the system tray icon anytime to adjust pet visibility or open controls.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the home intro screen layout and copy.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses many users, but historical finish redesigns consistently underperform or hurt conversion.

candidates.title: Pick Path Welcome Sound Effect Greeting
candidates.change: Play a welcoming sound effect and render a friendly mascot greeting component on the initial story screen.
candidates.why: The first step choose_path takes median 8s and mean 514s; delighting users upfront increases initial momentum.

components.text: Hello! Choose how you would like to meet your pet.

guard.reason: Valid addition of sound effect and mascot greeting components to the story screen.

candidates.score_note: Delight feature targeting long mean time on choose_path, requiring media assets and code release.

candidates.title: Sign In Deferred After Pet Selection Reorder
candidates.change: Move sign_in to occur after pet friend selection and photo upload, letting users select their companion first.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion sits at 72.9%; building emotional attachment to a selected pet before sign-in improves conversion.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of the sign-in step to occur after pet selection.

candidates.score_note: Reordering flow requires heavy development effort; single historical test showed slight positive gain (+0.8%).

candidates.title: Pick Friend Character Trait Comparison Hint
candidates.change: Add clear hint text describing how different pets behave on the desktop during selection.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% and takes median 89s because users struggle to choose among pets.

pick_friend.hint: Each pet has unique desktop behavior: playful pets explore your desktop while calm pets stay cozy near the tray.

guard.reason: Valid hint text describing character traits added to the pick friend screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets low adoption conversion (60.9%) with low-cost simple hint text configuration.
